### Ethio Grooves with Hewan

![Ethio Grooves](news/hewan.png)

THENCF presents ETHIO GROOVES at the Ballina Arts Centre, featuring Dublin-based Ethiopian DJ Hewan.

Hewan is a vinyl collector with special interest in Ethiopian modern and traditional music from the 60s/70s and all African grooves from the same era. Her selections cover afro-funk, afro-beat, high-life, and rare finds of all genres of music from Africa.

### About Hewan

Besides her monthly radio show on Dublin Digital Radio, Hewan has been part of Donal Dineen's Backstory guest DJs and played at ATN, Body & Soul, Cork Jazz festivals and various venues across Dublin and the counties. She has also supported and played with local and international DJs and artists like Hailu Mergia and Def Nettle.

### Event Details

- **Date:** Friday 20th September 2024
- **Time:** 9pm until midnight
- **Location:** Ballina Arts Centre Mezzanine/Bar
